\[ \logb(5^k, 3^{k^2}) = \frac{\ln (3^{k^2})}{\ln (5^k)} = \frac{k^2 \ln 3}{k \ln 5} = \frac{k \ln 3}{\ln 5} \]

We have:
\[ \logb(9^k, 25^k) = \frac{\ln (25^k)}{\ln (9^k)} = \frac{k \ln 25}{k \ln 9} = \frac{\ln 25}{\ln 9} \]

\[ \left( \frac{\ln 3}{\ln 5} \cdot 210 \right) \cdot \left( \frac{\ln 5}{\ln 3} \cdot 100 \right) = 210 \cdot 100 = 21000 \]
